frames.title: Chop vegetables
frames.description: Front-right view. Standing behind a thick wooden butcher cutting block on sturdy legs, chopping carrots with a kitchen knife in right hand, left hand safely curled around carrot. Vegetables and bowl on block.

frames.title: Peel potatoes
frames.description: Same cutting block front-left view. Peeling a potato above a small bowl with short peeling knife, vegetable skins on block.

frames.title: Knead dough
frames.description: Same block right-side view. Kneading a mound of dough with both hands, flour and a small bowl on block.

frames.title: Stir cauldron
frames.description: Front-right view. Stirring a stew in a cauldron on a low iron stand with a long wooden spoon, one hand steadying handle with cloth. No fire needed.

frames.title: Mix ingredients
frames.description: Same wooden cutting block front-right view. Mixing ingredients in a large wooden bowl with spoon, eggs and flour nearby.

frames.title: Serve stew
frames.description: Front-left view at cutting block, ladling stew from a pot into a wooden serving bowl held in the other hand.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
